ranking: canonical participants when active is RelO
stableSort: authored polar angle around active home
focus_targets.slotAssignment: For each ring preserve sorted circular order. Test 16 rotations at 22.5 degree increments; choose the rotation minimizing sum of squared wrapped angular displacement; tie uses smallest rotation index. Core stays at authored home. All unselected nodes stay at authored homes.
focus_targets.transition: interpolate current rendered position to pure target under active txId; abort returns no semantic mutation.

camera.safeRect: pane bounds minus title/navigation/Reader/modal-safe margins and safe-area insets
camera.neutral: fit all visible authored homes to target occupancy 0.80
camera.laterFocus: preserve transform when envelope is inside; otherwise minimal pan; refit only when more than 20% of focus envelope lies outside safe rect

requiredPriority: canonical RelO participants under RelO focus
direct focus members needed to read relation
RNO and MNO structural anchors inside current focus
labels.rule: score every candidate; choose minimum valid cost. Required labels must have zero label/body/chrome overlap. Suppress lower priority when no valid placement. Active label may not be suppressed; camera must reconcile and solve again.

requirements: same owner at pointerdown and pointerup
suppress compatible synthetic click after pointer commit
pointer.keyboard: commits the roving-focus node directly; pointer solver is not used.

route.append: only COMMIT_OBJECT and onboarding direct commit when id changes
route.presentation: virtualized complete history; compact strip may show first plus recent tail without deleting events

trace.wear: stable BFS over currently visible canonical base links only; deterministic canonical-index neighbor ordering; cap 7 passes per edge
trace.afterglow: deadline timestamps; desktop max 8 / 10s; mobile max 3 / 4s; resume removes expired without replay
trace.clear: cancels all owned timers and leaves Route unchanged

modals.replacement: close current without intermediate background focus, open replacement, update invoker
closeFallback: recorded invoker if connected and visible
logical navigation control for modal kind
modals.escape: tooltip first, then modal, then transient preview; never clears semantic history
